description: This source file defines an onboarding flow UI for an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It includes multiple steps such as welcoming, gateway setup (QR code scanning or manual input), permissions granting, and final verification of connection. The file manages UI state, permission checks, gateway endpoint parsing, and user interactions for onboarding new gateways and configuring app permissions.

classes.name: OnboardingStep
classes.description: Enumerates the steps of the onboarding process: Welcome, Gateway setup, Permissions, Final check.

classes.name: GatewayInputMode
classes.description: Specifies whether the gateway connection is set up via QR code or manual input.

classes.name: PermissionToggle
classes.description: Lists various permission toggles that the user can enable or disable during onboarding.

classes.name: SpecialAccessToggle
classes.description: Lists special access toggles such as notification listener.

methods.name: OnboardingFlow
methods.description: Main composable that manages and displays the onboarding UI flow, handling state, user interactions, and step progression.

methods.name: canFinishOnboarding
methods.description: Determines whether onboarding can be completed based on connection states.

methods.name: isPermissionGranted
methods.description: Checks if a specific permission is granted for a given context.

methods.name: qrScannerErrorMessage
methods.description: Provides an error message when QR code scanner cannot start.

methods.name: isNotificationListenerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if notification listener access is enabled.

methods.name: openNotificationListenerSettings
methods.description: Opens the device settings page for notification listener access.

methods.name: hasMotionCapabilities
methods.description: Checks if the device has motion-related sensors like accelerometer or step counter.
